_comment: Tu khoa cho OCR Lexical Guard cua Tang 1 (tools/stage1_normalizer.py: coarse_orientation).
Dung de xac nhan anh dang dung chieu 0 do hay nguoc 180 do: OCR dai 35% dau trang, dem so tu khoa xuat hien.
So khop chuoi con tren van ban da chuan hoa (bo dau tieng Viet, UPPERCASE, ky tu khac chu/so -> khoang trang).
Tu khoa co dau cung duoc, se tu chuan hoa khi nap. Danh sach nay gan voi KIDO va cac sieu thi — doi khach hang thi sua file nay.
Thieu file / loi doc / danh sach rong -> lexical guard TAT (khong co ban du phong hardcode trong Python):
in RuntimeWarning va moi trang ghi truong `lexical_guard = {enabled: false, ...}` vao JSON ket qua.
